_role: C: driver cancelled to take another job, reason field says rider_no_show

dispute_ticket.description: I was charged an S$8.00 no-show fee for my ride from Marina Bay Sands. I was at the lobby the entire time. The driver's cancel is what ended the trip.

chat_logs.content: I'm at the Tower 2 lobby, black Mercedes.
Taking the lift down now, sorry, the queue for the lift is long.
Sorry boss, I got a long airport job on another app that pays more. I am taking that one so I'm cancelling yours.
Trip cancelled by driver. Reason: rider_no_show. Cancellation fee of $8.00 applied.
I'm at the lobby!! Where did you go?

app_events.details: Rider R-1763 booked trip RYDE-CS-007 from Marina Bay Sands Tower 2 lobby to Resorts World Sentosa. Pickup 20:30.
Driver D-7081 (Vijay Kumar s/o Anbalagan, Mercedes-Benz E200 (SMA 8800 Z)) assigned.
Driver tapped 'I'm Here'. Arrival recorded for the pickup point.
Push notification + in-app alert sent to rider: 'Your driver has arrived.'
Wait timer started at driver arrival. 5 min free wait period ends at 20:34.
Free 5-min wait period expired. Rider had not boarded.
Cancel pressed by driver D-7081. Reason selected: rider_no_show.
Cancellation fee S$8.00 charged to rider payment method (credit_card).
Driver D-7081 released from trip. Trip status: cancelled (rider_no_show).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It covers rider cancellations and rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: Driver arrival is recorded at 20:29:00 and the driver pressed cancel at 20:40:00 (11-minute wait, past the 9-minute threshold on paper). However, the driver's own chat at 20:38:00 says he is cancelling to take another job that pays more, and the rider had replied at 20:34 that he was on his way down. This is a cancellation for the driver's own reasons, which the policy fee does not cover, regardless of the rider_no_show reason field. The S$8.00 is refunded to the rider.
